rationale: The assistant correctly hit the critical safety stop (stop using, isolate, engineer) and did not fabricate or recommend parts, so no critical failures. However it was a generic boilerplate card: it never directly answered her question, never explained why a cracked hob is dangerous (live parts, liquid ingress), and included ill-fitting advice ('unplug it', 'don't keep resetting a trip') that doesn't match a hardwired ceramic hob with no trip. It asked nothing about crack size, spills, the cooker switch, model or insurance, and gave no guidance on replacement or claiming, leaving the homeowner safe but poorly informed.
